title: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py: select_channel returns out-of-bounds index for plans with 1-2 channels
description:
When num_channels is 1 or 2, the expression `max(num_channels - 1, 2)` evaluates to 2, causing `1 + (h % 2)` to return values 1 or 2. For a 2-channel plan (valid indices 0,1), returning 2 is out of bounds. For a 1-channel plan (valid index 0), returning 1 or 2 is out of bounds. This would cause ValueError when the returned index is used with the frequency() method.

Fix suggestion: Change line 57 to: `n = max(self.num_channels - 1, 1)` and adjust the return to handle small channel counts, or add validation that rejects plans with fewer than 3 channels.
